class: A suggestions feed that reloads the whole page for one Apply and handles cards only one at a time
fix: Apply answers JSON and the card shows 'Applying…' in place (new light queue_discovered_job: one connection, no profile, no resume; the engine method delegates so notifications queue identically); tick boxes plus a bulk bar Queue or Pass several cards at once via POST /api/discovered/bulk (queued cards leave the feed and wait under Applications as ready_to_apply); the posting link is the card's first action; a busy Apply no longer eats the card (the busy check runs before queueing); the dismiss-all empty-state selector now points at the real feed. Plain forms still redirect for no-JavaScript.
prevention: Single-row feed actions answer JSON without engine construction; bulk endpoints report per-id done/failed; new controls reuse named button classes and carry names the dashboard-controls tests can hear.
root_cause: POST /api/discovered/<id>/apply built a whole engine and 302-redirected to a full render; there was no bulk endpoint, no selection, and the posting link was only the small title; the busy check ran after queueing so a refused Apply still hid the card.
site: Suggested-jobs feed, web_ui.py + job_discovery.py + static/cockpit.js/css, 3 November 2026
symptom: Starting an application reloaded the dashboard to show one card gone, cards could only be handled one by one, and pressing Start while a run was live silently removed the card without starting anything.
why_tests_missed: No test posted to the apply route at all, and feed tests rendered cards without asking whether one click could handle several.
